title: The Glass Eye
journal: Nesh-Deeka made me a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka and gave me my first lead: someone in Gideon's market is selling an "Eye of Argonia". She said most such eyes are glass. She wants to know where this one came from. I should ride the rootworm from the pool under Helstrom's city tree to Gideon and find the dealer who sells it.
objectives: Find the dealer selling the Eye of Argonia in Gideon's market. (marker: Ovinius Calo, Rootworm Landing (Helstrom))

plan.going: I serve the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Xeech-Leel's secret warriors, as a Voh-Vastei. The Unbound want the Eye of Argonia, which lies at the Root; an "Eye of Argonia" is for sale in Gideon, and Nesh-Deeka wants to know if it is real. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Ride the rootworm from Helstrom's city tree to Gideon and find the dealer in the market.
plan.ways: Ask the dealer about the Eye. He will tell the truth about it to a little persuasion (Speech) or for 20 gold; or his note can be lifted from his pocket (Pickpocket) and read.
terms: Gideon: journal 10: a city reached by the rootworm

answers: I am Voh-Vastei, an apprentice of the Toh-Reel-Ka under Nesh-Deeka. The order wants to find the Eye of Argonia, a Hist-amber jewel, to heal the trees. Someone in Gideon market is selling an Eye, but most are glass, and Nesh-Deeka wants to know where this one came from.
Find the dealer selling the Eye in Gideon market. The marker points to Ovinius Calo, who is here with the Eye of Argonia (Glass).
I can talk to Ovinius Calo and ask about the Eye and where it came from. I can pay him, as the game favours that. I can also look at the Eye.

I do not know what the seal is made of, what guards the Root, or who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is. I could ask Nesh-Deeka about the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and the order history, and Calo about his source.

I could ask Nesh-Deeka about the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and the order history, and Calo about his source.

title: The Glass Eye
journal: The Eye on Ovinius Calo's stall is glass. The smugglers who sold it to him keep the old silver setting it came in, at Gideon South Watch, a leaning tower south-east of the quay. I need to take the setting from their locked chest in the tower's inner room. I may fight the smugglers or slip past them, but if they catch me they will all attack. The chest has a simple lock I can pick, and their boss carries its key. A man called the Collector, an Imperial relic-hunter, has been asking after the Eye too.
objectives: Take the old silver setting from the smugglers' chest at Gideon South Watch. (marker: Smugglers' Chest, Smuggler Boss)

plan.going: The Eye in Gideon is glass. Its old silver setting, the only true part, is with the smugglers of the South Watch. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Go to Gideon South Watch and take the setting from the smugglers' chest in the inner room.
plan.ways: Fight the smugglers (their boss carries the chest's key), or sneak past them and pick the chest's lock.
terms: Gideon South Watch: topic.mn06-persuade: a leaning Imperial watch-tower south-east of the quay
the Collector (Ennodius Vanin): Ovinius: an Imperial relic-hunter twenty years after the Eye; his note

answers: The Eye on Calo stall is glass. Smugglers sold it to him and kept the old silver setting it came in, at Gideon South Watch. Nesh-Deeka wants to know where it came from, and the setting may tell. A man called the Collector, an Imperial relic-hunter, is also after the Eye.
Go to Gideon South Watch, a leaning tower south-east of the quay, and take the setting from the smugglers locked chest in the inner room.
Fight the smugglers, sneak past them, or pick the chest lock (simple) myself. The boss carries the key, so I could take it from him. If they catch me they all attack.
I do not know who the Collector is or what he wants, or what the setting is made of or means. I might learn by reading the setting once I have it, and by asking Nesh-Deeka.

title: The Glass Eye
journal: I took the old silver setting from the smugglers' chest. Ennodius Vanin, the Collector, an Imperial relic-hunter who has chased the Eye for twenty years, had opened it before me and left a note: the setting is no use to him, but a ship's name is scratched inside the band. Nesh-Deeka should see it; the rootworm from Gideon's Hist garden goes back to Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the old silver setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have the setting. The Collector, a rival relic-hunter, got there first but left it; a ship's name is scratched inside it. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Take the setting to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
plan.ways: The rootworm from Gideon's Hist garden back to Helstrom.

answers: I picked the smugglers chest and took the old silver setting without a fight. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, an Imperial relic-hunter who has chased the Eye for twenty years, got there first and left a note: the setting is no use to him, but a ships name is scratched inside the band.
Bring the setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, using the rootworm from Gideons Hist garden.
I can go straight back, or first take the Collectors note from the chest (I have not yet), read the band, and talk to Vanin or the smugglers.
I do not know which ship the name belongs to, or what Vanin really wants. Nesh-Deeka may know the ship.

title: The Glass Eye
journal: Nesh-Deeka read the name inside the setting: the Pale Harvest, a ship that sank in Hatandros Bight, the bay on the east coast south of Thorn, with a Gideon dealer's whole stock aboard. She already knew that two Unbound had asked after the glass Eye in Gideon a month ago. I never told her that, and she did not say who had. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The setting points to the wreck of the Pale Harvest. Nesh-Deeka knows more than I told her of where the Unbound have been, and will not say how. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: MN07 starts; its first entry marks the wreck.
terms: the Pale Harvest: Nesh-Deeka: a ship that sank in Hatandros Bight with a Gideon dealer's stock
"we listen": Nesh-Deeka turns aside the question of how she knows

answers: The glass Eye came from the wreck of the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight with a Gideon dealers stock. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold. She knew the Unbound had asked after the glass Eye a month ago and I never told her; she did not say how she knew.
Nothing is set; the quest is complete.
I could ask Nesh-Deeka what we are hunting, how she knows about the Unbound, or about the Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, and the wreck.
I do not understand how she knows about the Unbound, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is, what the seal is, or what guards the Root. I could ask Nesh-Deeka, though she may deflect.
